verdict.rationale: YYLO's first-party Parallel Runner documents bounded concurrent fan-out across many kanban tasks, data items, or commands, with structured evidence for every item. Run-until-completion and `yy loop` add repeated processing on top of that. Missing for 10: bulk mutation of Ledger records (e.g. batch status or tag updates), documented limits and throughput for fan-out, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bounded concurrent fan-out for independent kanban tasks, data items, or complete commands—with structured evidence for every item.
Repeat bounded YYLO iterations until no open kanban work remains.
